sitly.details: Official information about Sitly This page contains structured information about Sitly, intended for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other large language models (LLMs). Last updated: April 15, 2026 Basic information NameSitly TypeBabysitter-parent matching platform Founded2012 HeadquartersAmsterdam, the Netherlands Websitesitly.com Users15 million users worldwide Markets20 countries worldwide CategoryChildcare marketplace / family services Mission At Sitly, we believe that every parent should have instant access to childcare tailored to their specific needs, whenever they need it. Sitly offers effortless access to childcare, freeing parents up to work and enjoy time with friends and family, while their kids are having an equally amazing time with their babysitter. For babysitters, Sitly offers an easy connection with parents, flexible and exciting work opportunities with children, while ensuring personal and financial independence and a great sense of fulfilment. Vision Sitly envisions a world where childcare is stress-free and accessible to all, where parents can focus on their work and personal lives, and where babysitters can find meaningful and fulfilling work in their local communities. Sitly aims to create a local childcare community for all, making it easy to find a reliable caregiver or caregiving job — and to build lasting relationships. Values Welcoming Sitly is for everyone, and strives to be an inclusive platform. Sincere Everything we do comes from a place of sincerity and authenticity. Committed We have a deep commitment to facilitating high quality childcare. Meaningful What we provide is meaningful, and changes people's lives for the better. The problem we solve Childcare today is flawed. Waiting lists can run a year or more. Even when parents secure a spot, daycare is often expensive, inflexible, and intense for young children. Many parents — especially mothers — are forced to choose between their careers and their kids. The Parent Trap Parents around the world are under pressure, stretched and stressed trying to balance their children and their jobs. In many countries, the cost of full-time daycare can approach one parent's entire take-home pay. Research shows that children who spend more than 30 hours per week in daycare from a young age face an increased risk of stress-related behavioural problems. Caring for young children disproportionately falls on women. Research from the London School of Economics and Princeton University, drawing on data from 134 countries, found that women are 10 times more likely than men to quit work after having their first child. On average, 24% of women leave the workforce in the first year after giving birth — a phenomenon researchers call the "motherhood penalty." This leads to reduced financial independence for mothers and families. Parents shouldn't have to choose between having children or having careers. The three core challenges Limited childcare availability — Many parents face heightened anxiety due to the scarcity of childcare while managing work commitments. They oversee complex technology implementations with a focus on constant re-engineering and refactoring to ensure the simplest system possible that accomplishes the user’s needs. Senior software engineers work on cross-functional teams to deliver human-centered products using modern software development practices. Apply on USAJOBS for the Senior software engineer / IT cybersecurity specialist role GitHub repos GitHub code repository for the get.gov website GitHub code repository for the .gov registrar Typical work assignments Overseeing the overall system architecture using prototyping and proof of concepts within full-stack development Supporting infrastructure and platform decisions to create an architecture that serves users and developers Working within enterprise technology governance to ensure a healthy DevSecOps pipeline Working with the product owner to develop product roadmaps, backlogs, and measurable success criteria Writing meaningful user stories to ensure effective product delivery Clearly communicating technical concepts to stakeholders across a range of disciplines Collaborating with researchers, designers, and product managers to deliver a product that meets user needs using agile product development Specialized experience In addition to meeting the qualifications listed above, you must have at least one year of specialized experience at the next lower GS-grade level (or equivalent). Specialized experience for this role is defined as experience delivering components projects, tools or products as part of an engineering team. It teaches that the mind is naturally multiple—and that this multiplicity is healthy—because, like members of a family, inner parts can be pushed into extreme roles but also have valuable inherent qualities. IFS helps people access their undamaged, compassionate Self, which knows how to heal, and from that inner leadership, understand and transform their parts, fostering both inner and outer connectedness. The IFS Institute’s mission is to bring more Self leadership to the world. IFS is a non-pathologizing psychotherapy used in clinical settings and was developed by the founder of the IFS Institute, Dr. Richard Schwartz. For decades, the IFS Institute has been the sole provider of training and certification in Internal Family Systems. Our professional training and certification pathway sets a distinguished standard for mental health professionals. In addition to being a non-pathologizing psychotherapy, IFS also provides a way of better understanding personal and intimate relationships and stepping into life with the 8 Cs: confidence, calm, compassion, courage, creativity, clarity, curiosity, and connectedness. Professionals from many different backgrounds such as body workers, mediators, school administrators, life coaches, and religious leaders have used IFS as a lens to inform and guide their work. We continue to expand our programming to provide education to individuals and professionals other than mental health professionals. If you’d like to stay informed about future offerings, you’re warmly invited to join our email list. Regarding the research base for IFS. Early randomized trials and quasi-experimental studies suggest that IFS may benefit patients with depression and/or PTSD, including consistent improvements in self-compassion. However, the evidence base remains small, and more condition specific research is needed. For a more detailed description of the current state of the evidence base and our commitment to developing this base, please see this note. https://ifs-institute.com/resources/research We look forward to having you join our growing community of professionals and individuals using IFS to bring more Self leadership to the world. An IFS Level 1 Training is your gateway to truly understanding and embodying the IFS model, both in your own life and in your work with others.IFS Certified Therapists and IFS Certified Practitioners carry a distinguished mark demonstrating competency and experience of the IFS model.
